interface.signature: check(N: int, M: int, Edges: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of edges M must be between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge[0] <= N and 1 <= edge[1] <= N for edge in Edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex in the edges must be between 1 and N inclusive.
Each edge must be a list of exactly two vertices.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(len(path) == N and len(set(path)) == N for path in generate_paths(N, Edges))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there exists a Hamiltonian path in the graph, otherwise false.
